verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee exposes several controls that let a developer tune when/how much content is returned: wait_for CSS/XPath selector before returning HTML, JS scenarios with explicit wait/click/scroll steps, block_ads/block_resources to speed up requests, and a cost-ladder 'auto' mode that escalates configuration only as needed. These give real latency/completeness tradeoffs, but there's no explicit timeout or partial-content-streaming parameter, and no independent/hands-on evidence validating actual latency behavior. missing for 10: documented explicit timeout/wait-time cap parameter, evidence of streaming or partial-return behavior, independent benchmarks confirming latency tradeoffs work as documented.
